roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/list-detail/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: List-detail page: a ListView of records beside the open one, with Empty when none is open; below 640 the list drills to a full-page detail.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
The list is one kit ListView with selection="single" at 640 and up; the open record is the selected row
One URL per record (here #INV-1842; /invoices/:id in an app). The list with nothing open is its own URL
At 640 and up the detail sits beside the list (layout-split); with nothing open it is kit Empty that says so and offers one neutral Button
Below 640 the list fills the page and rows drill (interaction="drill"); the record opens full page under a bar with a ghost Invoices back button to the list, and Back returns focus to that row
Status is a Badge with an icon and a word, and lateness is text ("17 days late"), never colour alone
defaults: Demo is Northwind's invoices: Overdue filter, oldest first, with search by customer or invoice

At 640 and up the list column carries the Invoices PageHeader and New invoice; the record pane has the id, a status Badge, the customer line, and Ask on the left with Download PDF and Retry payment (the one primary) on the right
Record body: an amount strip, Line items (Table with a total) and Payment history (ListView, oldest first)
Below 640 rows show the invoice number only; the record keeps item and amount in Line items and lists the latest payment first. Actions sit in the body; there is no sticky bottom bar
